'''''Bauhinia tomentosa''''', also known as '''yellow bauhinia'''<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://davesgarden.com/guides/pf/go/2066/|title=PlantFiles: Yellow Bauhinia, Yellow Bell Orchid Tree|website=Dave's Garden|language=en|access-date=2017-08-04}}</ref> or '''yellow bell orchid tree''', is a species of plant in the family [[Fabaceae]]. It is found in [[South Africa]], [[Mozambique]], [[Zimbabwe]], [[Tropical Africa]], [[India]], and [[Sri Lanka]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.plantzafrica.com/plantab/bauhintoment.htm|title=Bauhinia tomentosa {{!}} PlantZAfrica.com|website=www.plantzafrica.com|access-date=2019-07-20|archive-date=2016-12-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210151417/http://www.plantzafrica.com/plantab/bauhintoment.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Description==
Yellow bauhinia is a small tree with a maximum height of {{convert|4|m|ft|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.smgrowers.com/products/plants/plantdisplay.asp?plant_id=3452|title=Bauhinia tomentosa, Yellow Bauhinia, Shrub|website=Plant Information|access-date=2017-08-04}}</ref> It has drooping slender branches with multiple scrambling stems. The bark is greyish, smooth, and sometimes hairy, which gives its specific name ''tomentosa''. Greenish leaves are deeply divided and elliptic in nature; margin entire. Flowers  are bell-shaped with large, yellow petals with a dark maroon patch at the base. The fruit is a pale-brown pod.<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.worldagroforestry.org/treedb/AFTPDFS/Bauhinia_tomentosa.PDF | title = Bauhinia tomentosa | website = worldagroforestry.org }}</ref>  Extracts of the plant's roots have ''[[in vitro]]'' antimicrobial activity against [[Gram-positive bacteria]].<ref>{{cite journal | pmc = 2950383 | pmid=20931080 | doi=10.4103/0973-1296.66937 | volume=6 | issue=23 | title=Antimicrobial activity of Bauhinia tomentosa and Bauhinia vahlii roots | year=2010 | journal=Pharmacogn Mag | pages=204–7 | last1 = Dugasani | first1 = S | last2 = Balijepalli | first2 = MK | last3 = Tandra | first3 = S | last4 = Pichika | first4 = MR | doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |pmid=20853598 | volume=21 | issue=2 | title=Bauhinia tomentosa stimulates the immune system and scavenges free radical generation in vitro | year=2010 | journal=J Basic Clin Physiol Pharmacol | pages=157–68 | last1 = Kannan | first1 = N | last2 = Renitta | first2 = RE | last3 = Guruvayoorappan | first3 = C | doi=10.1515/jbcpp.2010.21.2.157| s2cid=88090375 }}</ref>
